text: **R54.10 — the phase-A control quote does not match its cited receipt.** The report quotes `CTL_R53 (the round-53 final tree, 58/64, rekeyed=0/30)` under the pointer `control/controls-a.stdout`, but that file’s `CTL_R53` line prints `rekeyed=0/7` (the round-54 counter’s arm-3 denominator). `0/30` belongs to the round-53 counter’s own receipt `control/r53-counter-at-88afa941.stdout`. Re-derive: `cat .ufo/evidence/round-54/control/controls-a.stdout`. Same shape as R54.3/R54.4: a real number cited against the wrong file.

**R55.2 — a quoted total its own receipt contradicts.** Report quotes `T55W1ScribeSkill` as `grammar=9/9 … note=9/9 skill=1/1 total=0`; the committed `c2-integrated.out:44` reads `total=1 C2_R55_PASS=false` (`rev=08d64e946006`). This is the R54.3 class recurring inside its own correction round. Fix: quote the receipt or name the run whose line you quote.

**R55.4 — a stale control sentence.** The report says `CTL_SKIP_c2` "was still running at filing"; the committed `control/controls-a.stdout` (at `4c04c1d3`, 14:51:26 — before the report) already reads `CTL_SKIP_c2 … total=4 C2_R55_PASS=false` and `CONTROLS_A: 5/5 as pre-registered`.

**R55.5 — the deciding gate cannot compare the revision it certifies.** `deciding-run.sh` never compares a `CTL` line's `rev=` with the revision under test; row 1's defect is the same shape one level up. Declared by the lane as a residual; route it into QUALITY as a criterion with its lesson pointer when the frozen script is next allowed to change.

**R55.6 — uncommitted round work at closure.** Seven round-55 evidence files created before the lane tip were never committed: `w1/T55W1ExecRekeyPrep-receipts/{base,cand,floor}.json` (13:55:47), `…/rekey.json` (13:58:42), `w1/T55W1ExecNoHarm-receipts/coldread-at-base.json` (14:02:24), `w1/T55W1CritClaimShape-receipts/coldread-HEAD.json` (14:31:03), `w2/T55W2ScoutColdread-receipts/inputs.json` (14:34:53). Same class as R54.6, twice repeated.

**R55.7 — closure-environment contamination (not lane debt).** Concurrent non-author seats write inside the lane repo: `after/c2.stdout` was rewritten after the tip with `C2_R55: rev=4c04c1d33377 … total=0 C2_R55_PASS=true` (uncommitted), and 14 tracked `T55W1MutC2-receipts` files were deleted from the working tree mid-closure. That green line is **not** lane evidence and is not cited above. Closure seats should work in scratch clones; operators of the closure harness should note it.

**R56.1** Replace SKILL page-local line anchors with heading/function anchors (QUALITY 34), then re-read the touched sections; do not insert text above line 45 again without re-deriving anchors in the same commit.
**R56.2** Fix the `## Standing rules` row 1 code for `role=verdict` with `--paths` (`RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT`), and make the docs arm check code-to-role truth, not code presence.

**R56.3** Replace the `14/14` `recheck:` in `corpus/knowledge/receipt-revision-binding.md` with the 19/19 command (as a new superseding entry or errata the `recheck:` line itself points to); index the entry in `corpus/README.md`.

**R56.4** The 13 of 18 bound ledger entries whose `external_inputs` digest labels are not the sha256 of `git show C0:<path>` (lane count: `SOURCES.md` 13, `QUALITY.md` 6): record the referent or re-bind.

**R56.5** Pre-register the two controls generations (bootstrap, then scored) in `controls.sh`'s header, and add a producer-provenance discriminator for the "own receipts" arm (the C2 do-nothing blind spot) before any claim rests on it again.
